title: Add SQLite-backed TimelineStore for compressed checkpoints and default scenario timeline persistence

sections.what: Offload TimelineManager branch trees and compressed per-tick world checkpoints into a dedicated SQLite store (saves/timeline.db) so scenarios persist multi-month timelines by default without bloating JSON files.
sections.why: Keeping full world checkpoint dicts only in memory or inline inside scenario JSON files causes large JSON bloat on multi-month timelines and loses single-branch checkpoints across restarts.
sections.how: Create engine/timeline_store.py (SQLite WAL mode, timeline_branches + timeline_checkpoints tables with zlib-compressed JSON snapshots). Wire optional store + world_id into TimelineManager (engine/timeline.py) so record_checkpoint, fork_branch, switch_branch, and _find_checkpoint_at_or_before read/write through SQLite and hydrate cleanly on boot via routes/timeline_ops.py _get_timeline().

acceptance.text: engine/timeline_store.py stores branch metadata and gzip-compressed world checkpoints in SQLite (saves/timeline.db) keyed by (world_id, branch_id, tick)
TimelineManager persists and loads checkpoints through TimelineStore automatically when attached, surviving server restarts without bloating scenario JSON files
routes/timeline_ops.py attaches TimelineStore per active world_id and lazily hydrates checkpoints from SQLite on switch/fork/redo

custom.browser_ui: Multi-month timeline branches and checkpoints survive page reloads and server restarts automatically without slowing down Save Scenario or bloating scenario JSON files.
